set_title: Skin pressure and trauma signs: Nikolsky sign, Auspitz sign, Koebner phenomenon, Darier sign and Dermatographism
stem: A 52-year-old woman has had 3 weeks of painful oral erosions and now has flaccid blisters that rupture easily on her trunk. Gentle sideways rubbing of normal-looking skin next to a blister makes the top layer peel off. Biopsy shows intraepidermal acantholysis.
oneliner: 52F, oral erosions + flaccid blisters, rubbed normal skin peels off → ?

whyNot.A: Auspitz sign is bleeding under scale; she has **flaccid blisters and erosions**
whyNot.B: Koebner is new lesions at injury sites; hers is **rubbed normal skin peeling off**
whyNot.C: Darier sign is a wheal when a lesion is rubbed; her skin **peels off**
whyNot.E: Dermatographism gives wheals on stroking; her rubbed skin **shears off**

why: Sideways pressure on normal-looking skin that shears off the epidermis is the Nikolsky sign, from acantholysis. **Oral erosions with flaccid blisters** fit pemphigus vulgaris.

head: What it is
Classic cause
rows: New lesions along scratch or trauma
Rubbing a lesion makes it urticate
Wheals form along stroked normal skin

idea.rule: Rubbing normal skin shears off epidermis = Nikolsky = pemphigus vulgaris, SSSS, TEN.

set_title: Skin pressure and trauma signs: Nikolsky sign, Auspitz sign, Koebner phenomenon, Darier sign and Dermatographism
stem: A 40-year-old man has had silvery scaly plaques on both elbows and knees for 5 years. When a physician scrapes the scale off a plaque, tiny pinpoint bleeding spots appear on the red surface beneath.
oneliner: 40M, silvery plaques on elbows, scale removal → pinpoint bleeding → ?

whyNot.A: Nikolsky shears off skin on rubbing; his finding is **bleeding after scale removal**
whyNot.B: Koebner is new lesions at injury sites; his bleeding follows **scale removal**
whyNot.D: Darier sign is a wheal on rubbing; he has **pinpoint bleeding after scale removal**
whyNot.E: Dermatographism is wheals after stroking; he has **pinpoint bleeding when scale is removed**

why: Pinpoint bleeding after scale removal is the Auspitz sign. Thin suprapapillary plates leave dilated dermal capillaries exposed, as in **psoriasis**.

head: What it is
Classic cause
rows: New lesions along scratch or trauma
Rubbing a lesion makes it urticate
Wheals form along stroked normal skin

idea.rule: Scale removal causes pinpoint bleeding = Auspitz = psoriasis.
also: Neutrophil microabscesses in the stratum corneum
Nail pitting and psoriatic arthritis may follow

set_title: Skin pressure and trauma signs: Nikolsky sign, Auspitz sign, Koebner phenomenon, Darier sign and Dermatographism
stem: A 30-year-old man with chronic silvery scaly plaques on his elbows develops new linear plaques along an abdominal surgical scar and along a recent scratch. The new lesions appear at sites of injury (Koebner phenomenon).
oneliner: 30M, silvery elbow plaques + new plaques along a scar → ?
ask: Which condition best explains this sign?

whyNot.B: Pemphigus gives flaccid blisters; he has **silvery scaly plaques on the elbows**
whyNot.C: Mastocytosis gives brown macules that wheal; he has **silvery scaly plaques**
whyNot.D: Pityriasis rosea starts with one patch and resolves; he has **chronic elbow plaques**
whyNot.E: Atopic dermatitis is flexural and itchy; he has **silvery plaques on extensor surfaces**

why: New lesions along sites of injury are the Koebner phenomenon, seen in psoriasis, lichen planus and vitiligo. His **silvery scaly elbow plaques** point to psoriasis.

head: What it is
Classic cause
rows: New lesions along scratch or trauma
Rubbing a lesion makes it urticate
Wheals form along stroked normal skin

idea.rule: New lesions at trauma sites = Koebner; think psoriasis, lichen planus, vitiligo.
also: Warts and molluscum spread by autoinoculation
Pathergy in Behcet is a different response

set_title: Skin pressure and trauma signs: Nikolsky sign, Auspitz sign, Koebner phenomenon, Darier sign and Dermatographism
stem: A 2-year-old boy has several tan-brown macules on his trunk. When a physician strokes one, it becomes red, raised and itchy within minutes (Darier sign). He has had occasional facial flushing.
oneliner: 2-year-old boy, brown macules that swell and itch when rubbed → cell?
ask: Which cell type is increased in this condition?

whyNot.A: Melanocyte excess gives fixed macules; his lesions **swell and itch when rubbed**
whyNot.B: Plasma cells make antibodies and do not **release histamine when rubbed**
whyNot.C: Eosinophils do not make lesions **wheal within minutes of rubbing**
whyNot.E: Langerhans cell histiocytosis gives scaly rashes, not **macules that wheal on rubbing**

why: Rubbing a brown lesion makes it swell and itch because mast cells degranulate and release histamine, as in urticaria pigmentosa. **Wheal on rubbing** marks excess mast cells.

head: What it is
Classic cause
rows: New lesions along scratch or trauma
Rubbing a lesion makes it urticate
Wheals form along stroked normal skin

idea.rule: Rubbed brown macule wheals = Darier sign = mast cell excess (mastocytosis).

set_title: Face and atopy signs: Dennie-Morgan lines, Allergic shiners, Transverse nasal crease, Hutchinson sign and Hertoghe sign
stem: A 6-year-old boy has had itchy, dry, red patches in his elbow and knee creases since infancy. He has asthma, and his father has hay fever. Examination shows an extra skin fold below each lower eyelid.
oneliner: 6M, flexural itchy patches + extra fold below lower eyelids → ?

whyNot.A: Allergic shiners are dark circles; he has **an extra crease under each lower eyelid**
whyNot.B: Transverse nasal crease is across the nose; his fold is **under the eyelids**
whyNot.C: Hutchinson sign is nasal-tip vesicles; he has **dry itchy flexural patches**
whyNot.D: Hertoghe sign is lateral eyebrow loss; his brows are normal with **eyelid creases**

why: An extra fold below the lower eyelid is a Dennie-Morgan line, a marker of atopy. With **itchy flexural patches and asthma**, the atopic picture is clear.

head: What it is
Classic cause
rows: Vesicles on the tip of the nose
Zoster of V1 with eye risk
Loss of outer third of eyebrows

idea.rule: Extra lower-eyelid crease in an itchy child = Dennie-Morgan line = atopy.
also: Atopic triad: eczema, asthma, allergic rhinitis

set_title: Classic rash patterns: Herald patch, Christmas tree pattern, Wickham striae, Target lesions, Bull's-eye rash and Pathergy
stem: A 19-year-old woman noticed a single 3-cm oval pink scaly lesion on her abdomen. One week later, numerous smaller oval scaly lesions appeared on her trunk. She has no fever, and syphilis serology is negative.
oneliner: 19F, single oval scaly lesion, then many smaller trunk lesions → ?

whyNot.A: Wickham striae are lacy lines on papules; hers is **a single oval scaly patch**
whyNot.B: Target lesions have three zones; hers are **oval scaly patches**
whyNot.D: Bull's-eye rash expands with central clearing; hers is **a scaly oval patch**
whyNot.E: Pathergy is a pustule at needle-prick sites; she has **spontaneous scaly patches**

why: A solitary large oval scaly patch preceding a generalized eruption is the herald patch of pityriasis rosea. **Smaller trunk patches a week later** follow, and it resolves in weeks.

head: What it is
Classic cause
rows: Single large oval scaly patch first
Oval patches along skin cleavage lines on back
Lacy white lines on purple papules
Dusky center, pale ring, red edge
Expanding red ring with central clearing

idea.rule: Single oval scaly patch, then smaller trunk patches = herald patch = pityriasis rosea.
also: Rule out secondary syphilis and tinea

set_title: Classic rash patterns: Herald patch, Christmas tree pattern, Wickham striae, Target lesions, Bull's-eye rash and Pathergy
stem: A 50-year-old man has had 3 months of intensely itchy, flat-topped, violaceous polygonal papules on his wrists and ankles. A fine network of white lacy lines crosses the surface of the papules and his buccal mucosa.
oneliner: 50M, itchy violet flat-topped papules + white lacy lines → ?

whyNot.A: Herald patch is one oval scaly plaque; his lesions are **multiple flat violet papules**
whyNot.C: Target lesions are dusky-centered rings; his are **flat violet papules with white lines**
whyNot.D: Bull's-eye rash is an expanding ring; his are **itchy violet papules**
whyNot.E: Pathergy is a pustule after needle prick; his lesions are **spontaneous violet papules**

why: Lacy white lines over violet, flat-topped papules are Wickham striae of lichen planus. **Itchy wrist papules with buccal lace** seal it; hepatitis C is associated.

head: What it is
Classic cause
rows: Single large oval scaly patch first
Oval patches along skin cleavage lines on back
Lacy white lines on purple papules
Dusky center, pale ring, red edge
Expanding red ring with central clearing

idea.rule: Lacy white lines on violet papules = Wickham striae = lichen planus.
also: Biopsy shows sawtooth rete ridges and band-like lymphocytes

set_title: Classic rash patterns: Herald patch, Christmas tree pattern, Wickham striae, Target lesions, Bull's-eye rash and Pathergy
stem: A 28-year-old man has had three episodes in 2 years of painful lip blisters followed 1 week later by red lesions on his palms and extensor forearms. Each lesion has a dusky center, a pale ring and a red outer rim (target lesions). Mucosal involvement is minimal.
oneliner: 28M, recurrent lip blisters then target lesions on palms → trigger?
ask: Which of the following is the most common trigger?

whyNot.A: Mycoplasma triggers SJS-spectrum disease in children; he has **recurrent lip blisters before each episode**
whyNot.B: Drugs cause severe mucosal SJS or TEN; his episodes **follow recurrent lip blisters**
whyNot.C: Streptococcus triggers erythema nodosum; his target lesions **follow lip blisters**
whyNot.D: EBV causes mononucleosis; he has **recurrent lip blisters before target lesions**

why: Target lesions with a dusky center, pale ring and red rim are the hallmark of erythema multiforme. Recurrent **herpes labialis** makes HSV its most common trigger.

head: What it is
Classic cause
rows: Single large oval scaly patch first
Oval patches along skin cleavage lines on back
Lacy white lines on purple papules
Dusky center, pale ring, red edge
Expanding red ring with central clearing

idea.rule: Target lesions after recurrent lip blisters = erythema multiforme, usually HSV.
also: Mycoplasma and drugs cause SJS-spectrum disease
